info.title: Linkila Universal API
info.description: Create, manage, and analyze Linkila short links, domains, filters, redirection sessions, and access logs through the Linkila Public API v1.

get.description: Retrieves Linkila analytics counts by time interval.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Required interval granularity. Official values: day, hour, minute.

schema.description: Required interval granularity. Official values: day, hour, minute.

parameters.name: startTimestamp
parameters.description: Required ISO date-time start timestamp for the analytics interval.

schema.description: Required ISO date-time start timestamp for the analytics interval.

parameters.name: endTimestamp
parameters.description: Required ISO date-time end timestamp for the analytics interval.

schema.description: Required ISO date-time end timestamp for the analytics interval.

parameters.name: timezoneName
parameters.description: Required IANA timezone name used to group interval counts.

schema.description: Required IANA timezone name used to group interval counts.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional Linkila analytics filter object.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Analytics interval rows with datetime and visits.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates a redirection session in Linkila.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

shortURLId.description: Required Linkila short URL identifier for the redirection session.

session_url.description: Runtime-observed redirection session URL. Official docs name this as sessionUrl, but runtime returned session_url.

put.description: Updates an existing link in Linkila.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

link_id.description: Required Linkila link identifier from the editLink path.

changes.description: Object containing the Linkila link fields to update.

data.description: Updated Link record with id, title, defaultDestinationURL, shortUrls, tags, and filterDestinations.

get.description: Retrieves access log entries from Linkila.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Optional ISO date-time cursor; return access-log entries before this timestamp.

schema.description: Optional ISO date-time cursor; return access-log entries before this timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of access-log entries to return. Official maximum: 500.

schema.description: Maximum number of access-log entries to return. Official maximum: 500.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional Linkila analytics filter object.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

results.description: Access log entries with timestamp, linkId, shortURLId, ip, ref_url, region, language, deviceType, os_name, browser_name.

get.description: Retrieves a destination URL from Linkila and logs access.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: shortURL
parameters.description: Short URL to resolve. Provide either Short URL or Link ID.

schema.description: Short URL to resolve. Provide either Short URL or Link ID.

parameters.name: linkId
parameters.description: Link ID to resolve. Provide either Short URL or Link ID.

schema.description: Link ID to resolve. Provide either Short URL or Link ID.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Optional request IP address context for redirection resolution.

schema.description: Optional request IP address context for redirection resolution.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional request headers object for redirection resolution.

schema.description: Optional request headers object for redirection resolution.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

destination_url.description: Destination URL returned for the resolved short link.

post.description: Creates a new link and short URL in Linkila.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

targetURL.description: Required destination URL for the new Linkila short link.

domainName.description: Optional Linkila domain name for the generated short link.

slug.description: Optional custom slug for the generated short link.

title.description: Optional title for the generated short link.

deepLinkEnabled.description: Whether deep-link behavior should be enabled for the generated link.
